PCSTATS.AccessRoleHint: Users at or above this role see the PC Stats Overlays controls and can open the popout windows.
PCSTATS.ConfigMenuHint: Configure the Banner and Party Row overlays independently.
PCSTATS.TabBannerHint: Horizontal banner — a single rotating card (fields in a row) that shows one character at a time and cycles through sponsor messages. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (TV icon).
PCSTATS.TabVerticalCardHint: Vertical banner — same rotating card as the horizontal banner (one character at a time, sponsor messages, animations) but with fields stacked in a column. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (ID-card icon).
PCSTATS.TabPartyHint: Party row — shows every selected character at once, side by side. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (people icon). Line it up above your scene's character art.
PCSTATS.TabVerticalHint: Party column — shows every selected character stacked in a column. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (vertical-lines icon). Good for a side rail.
PCSTATS.TabTurnOrderHint: Turn order — shows the current combat's combatants in initiative order with the active turn highlighted. Updates live as turns advance. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (ordered-list icon). Roster filters don't apply here; use the players-only option in Combat & dice.
PCSTATS.HelpTurnOrderPlayersOnly: Only list character-type combatants in the turn order (hide NPCs/monsters).
PCSTATS.SelectCharactersHint: Pick which characters appear — this applies to all four overlays.
PCSTATS.NoCharacterActors: No character-type actors found in this world.
PCSTATS.FieldsHint: Drag rows by the handle to set the display order.
PCSTATS.GroupPlateHelp: The rounded background card behind each character's stats.
PCSTATS.GroupWindowHelp: The pop-out window OBS captures. Set the chroma-key color and the window size here.
PCSTATS.RosterFiltersHint: Optionally narrow who appears (applies to all overlays except the turn order).
PCSTATS.PortraitCropNote: Per-character crop, token art, accent frame and bio are set on the Characters tab.
PCSTATS.CopyAllHint: Save these settings and apply them to the other three overlays (each keeps its own window size).
PCSTATS.CopyAllConfirm: Copy this overlay's settings to all the other overlays? Their capture-window size is kept. This also saves your current changes.
PCSTATS.StylingHint: Only the characters selected above appear here.
PCSTATS.HelpTexture: Optional: use an image as the plate background instead of the color (e.g. a parchment texture). Leave blank to use the color above.
PCSTATS.HelpHpByHealth: When on, the HP numbers recolor by remaining health using the three colors and thresholds below.
PCSTATS.HelpPlateEntrance: Party Row / Column only — slides each plate in when the overlay opens.
PCSTATS.HelpMaxSize: Shrinks the whole overlay to fit within this pixel size, scaling the fonts with it. 0 = off (use the sizes above as-is).
PCSTATS.HelpCombatDuration: How long the reaction stays before the banner resumes.
PCSTATS.HelpDiceFlair: Bursts when a selected character rolls a natural 20 or 1 in chat.
PCSTATS.HelpSpotlight: Banner only — during combat, jumps to and holds on whoever's turn it is.
PCSTATS.CustomColorHint: Use a custom color for this field
PCSTATS.MessagesHint: Text slides (ads, shoutouts, announcements) mixed into the banner between characters. Banner only.
PCSTATS.MessagePlaceholder: e.g. Tonight's stream sponsored by Acme Dice!
PCSTATS.MessageFrequency: Show a message after every N characters (0 = off)
PCSTATS.CombatHint: Flash a damage/heal animation on a character whose HP changes, then resume. Use the toggle below to limit this to active combat only.
PCSTATS.HighlightActiveTurn: Highlight the character whose turn it is
PCSTATS.SpotlightCurrentTurn: Spotlight current turn (hold on active character)
PCSTATS.PrevCycleHint: Cycle the preview through your selected characters.
PCSTATS.CharactersHint: Choose which characters appear (shared by all four overlays) and set per-character styling like an accent frame color or using token art.
PCSTATS.IntroText: Featured intro text for this character
PCSTATS.BioText: Featured bio / quote for this character (shown under the name in the intro)
PCSTATS.BioPlaceholder: Bio, quote, or other info shown in the featured intro (optional)
PCSTATS.PronounsText: Pronouns for this character (shown by the Player field)
PCSTATS.CropHint: Frame this character's art inside the portrait. X/Y (0–100%) set the focal point; Zoom (1–5×) tightens the crop. The thumbnail previews it live.
PCSTATS.RotateInterval: Display each card for (seconds, 0 = no rotation)
PCSTATS.HelpFeaturedIntro: Before each character's card, play a short animated lead-in (a label + the character's name), then reveal their stats.
PCSTATS.HelpIntroPortraitSize: Size of the portrait in the featured-character lead-in (0 = hide it).
PCSTATS.HelpIntroBio: Size of the per-character bio/quote shown under the name. Set the text on the Characters tab.
PCSTATS.TestNotOpen: Open this overlay first (PC Stats Overlays menu), then test.
PCSTATS.TestNoActor: Select at least one character for this overlay first.
PCSTATS.CopyHint: Copy the look (appearance, combat, messages, fields) from one overlay to another. Keeps the target's own characters and window size.
PCSTATS.CopyConfirm: Copy settings to the target overlay? This overwrites its look and cannot be undone.
PCSTATS.ExportHint: Export all overlay settings to a file, or import a previously exported file.
PCSTATS.ImportFailed: Import failed — the file could not be read as valid settings.
PCSTATS.ResetConfirm: Reset this overlay's settings to the default parchment theme? This discards its current configuration and cannot be undone.
PCSTATS.HelpDamageCallouts: Float the rolled damage total when a selected character makes a damage roll.
PCSTATS.HelpReactionCallouts: Pop a callout when a character gains a condition, inspiration, a level, an exhaustion change, or breaks concentration.
PCSTATS.NoCharacters: No characters selected. Open the overlay settings to choose some.
PCSTATS.PopupBlocked: The overlay popup was blocked. Allow popups for your Foundry site and try again.
